description: 避難施設情報(指定緊急避難場所、指定避難所、福祉避難所 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] (series on G-spatial Information Center) is a series of datasets listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by N2EM. 茨城県 避難施設情報（指定緊急避難場所、指定避難所、福祉避難所）を市町村の公開情報からN2EMのボランティアメンバーが収集したもの。 【データ項目】 市区町村コード 施設名 住所 緯度 経度 電話番号 指定緊急避難場所(0:対応無し 1:対応 9:不明） 指定避難所(0:対応無し 1:対応 9:不明） 福祉避難所(0:対応無し 1:対応... Coverage: Japan. The portal lists 5 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher N2EM. Its tags are N2EM, かすみがうら市, つくばみらい市, つくば市, ひたちなか市. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2024-10-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Government of Japan Standard Terms of Use (compatible with CC-BY-4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
